notes.content:
Hey guys! Coming in with another update:

If you want to see my future games, you can go to my Steam creator page (https://store.steampowered.com/curator/42140544-NoTimeForAdventure/) and follow me! 
I will be publishing games in the future.

See you guys soon!
- NoTime

notes.title: All Click to Eleven Achievement guide & break from development
notes.content:
Hey guys, I know that a lot of you have been trying to 100% Click to Eleven, so in this post i will be showing you how to do so and also I have a bit more to talk about concerning the future of this game, and the development of more games from me in the future.

How to get all achievements:
Main achievements (numbers):

 1 - Click one time with the left mouse button
 2 - Click a total of two times with the left mouse button
 3 - Click a total of three times with the left mouse button
 4 - Click a total of 4 times with the left mouse button
 5 - Click a total of 5 times with the left mouse button
 6 - Click a total of 6 times with the left mouse button
 7 - Click a total of 7 times with the left mouse button
 8 - Click a total of 8 times with the left mouse button
 9 - Click a total of 9 times with the left mouse button
 10 - Click a total of 10 times with the left mouse button
 11 - Click a total of 11 times with the left mouse button
 69 - Click with the left mouse button until the number on the screen displays "69". There is currently no know way to achieve this. You will most likely be able to find an external way to stop the game from running the Application.Quit() function. (there is also a .5 second gap between clicking to eleven and when the game closes)
 420 - Click with the left mouse button until the number on the screen displays "420". There is currently no know way to achieve this. You will most likely be able to find an external way to stop the game from running the Application.Quit() function. (there is also a .5 second gap between clicking to eleven and when the game closes)
 -1 - Press the backspace key until the number on the screen displays "-1"
 -2 - Press the backspace key until the number on the screen displays "-2"
 -3 - Press the backspace key until the number on the screen displays "-3"
 -4 - Press the backspace key until the number on the screen displays "-4"
 -5 - Press the backspace key until the number on the screen displays "-5"
 -6 - Press the backspace key until the number on the screen displays "-6"
 -7 - Press the backspace key until the number on the screen displays "-7"
 -8 - Press the backspace key until the number on the screen displays "-8"
 -9 - Press the backspace key until the number on the screen displays "-9"
 -10 - Press the backspace key until the number on the screen displays "-10"
 -11 - Press the backspace key until the number on the screen displays "-11"


Playtime achievements (bugged as of 02/21/2024):

 1 hour - play the game for a total of 1 hour
 2 hours - play the game for a total of 2 hours
 10 hours - play the game for a total of 10 hours
 50 hours - play the game for a total of 50 hours
 100 hours - play the game for a total of 100 hours


Color achievements:

 pink - when you launch the game, a random background color is chosen, if the color is a light pink, this achievement will be awarded
 blue - when you launch the game, a random background color is chosen, if the color is blue, this achievement will be awarded
 yellow - when you launch the game, a random background color is chosen, if the color is yellow, this achievement will be awarded
 red - when you launch the game, a random background color is chosen, if the color is red, this achievement will be awarded
 purple - when you launch the game, a random background color is chosen, if the color is purple, this achievement will be awarded (my fav color btw)
 gren - when you launch the game, a random background color is chosen, if the color is green, this achievement will be awarded



Random achievements:

 mute - press the M key to mute the music.
 unmute - press the M key, once the music is muted, to unmute the music
 play - download and launch click to eleven on your device
 rebel - attempt to click with the right mouse button
 escape - press the ESC key on your keyboard
 Im Broke - find a secret text in the game when the screen displays the number "5" and the background color is: red, blue, yellow, Hot pink/intense Red, Toothpaste-y (the secret message shows my cashapp, which is $NoTimeForAdventure, definitely do not give me money
 tab - press the TAB key on your keyboard
 scary hour - launch the game at 3am (achievement will be fixed soon so that it is awarded even when game is in background)




Alright, now its time to talk about another topic that's been on my mind lately.
I really love game development and I want to kind of move on to bigger projects than this. I'm hoping to release a big project either later this year or next year. 



I don't really want to come on here and whine about personal issues, so I'm going to keep this pretty short. I'm going to take a small break from updating this game just so i can take a mental break, I will still talk in the discussion posts from time to time, and help anybody that is having issues with the game. Bye-bye guys! (shoutout to Dragsling, Griff, and Cole Crouch to supporting me via donations lol & please check out Click to 13 which was made by another developer)
